meta.side: contingent liabilities (off-budget) — NOT part of the budget total
meta.headline: Gujarat's outstanding guarantees: ₹4,699 cr — 3.46% of revenue receipts; ₹15,301 cr headroom under the ₹20,000 cr ceiling. Outside the on-budget total — the part of the books the budget does not show.
meta.off_budget_note: Outstanding guarantees ₹4,699 cr = 3.46% of revenue receipts. Top exposure: Sardar Sarovar Narmada Nigam Ltd (the dam SPV) at 30%.
meta.source: CAG State Finances Audit Report, year ended 31 Mar 2019, Govt of Gujarat (Report No. 2 of 2020)
meta.caveat: Contingent liabilities, not budget spending — a charge on the Consolidated Fund only if a guarantee is invoked. NOT part of the on-budget total. Source: CAG SFAR (ex Finance Accounts Statement 20). RBI 'State Finances' guarantees statement = pending cross-check.
